newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines declares half-day holiday on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Philippines declares half-day holiday on Thursday.

text.p: The Philippines declared a half-day holiday for all government offices on Thursday, but the Central Bank said normal banking hours would be observed.

"All employees of government offices, including government owned and controlled corporations, may take the afternoon off ... to enable them to participate in the observance of All Saints' Day," executive secretary Ruben Torres said in a circular released on Wednesday.
A Central Bank official said banking transactions would be cleared by the Central Bank which maintain a skeletal work force in the afternoon.
The Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP), which operates the Philippine Dealing System, said the foreign exchange market will be open until late afternoon.
Friday is a national holiday for All Saints Day.
